Knowledge facts: part C holds 42 fact blocks (sec07-F01 onward) from physical pages 28 to 30; part C2 holds 12 confusable blocks (sec07-R01 onward).
Exam authority: part A names the issuer, the September 2026 revision line and the written-test requirement; question count, passing standard, format and time limit are unknown.
VERIFY list:
- AZ-PARK-A-COUNT — written-test question count not printed in the manual (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- AZ-PARK-A-PASS — passing standard not printed; nothing shown to learners (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- AZ-PARK-A-FORMAT — item format not printed (owner EvidenceLibrarian).
- AZ-PARK-A-TIME — time limit not printed (owner EvidenceLibrarian).
- AZ-PARK-A-EDITION — issuer current-edition confirmation pending; issuer page was bot-challenged at intake (owner EvidenceLibrarian).
- AZ-PARK-D-FINE — accessible-parking fine amount not stated (owner EvidenceLibrarian).
- AZ-PARK-E-MARKET — market pack unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
- AZ-PARK-ETWO-TEARDOWN — competitive teardown unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
Dynamic facts: the list of Arizona interchanges using the diverging diamond design is not in the manual and can grow (for example sec07-F19); passing and parking rules change only by statute.
Index: exam authority in A; audience in B; knowledge facts with misconceptions, mnemonics, glossary and dynamic-fact lines in C; confusables in C2; accuracy in D; market in E and E2; definition-of-done matrix in G.
